placements.why: Establishes the top-level organizational stratum for managing the physical placement, maintenance, and asset protection of public community infrastructure.
placements.title: Deployment, placement, and safeguarding of shared public facilities and equipment
placements.frame: How should public equipment and community repair amenities be sited, configured, and protected in shared spaces?

placements.title: Public infrastructure placement prioritizes point-of-need incident geography over default convenience
placements.frame: Where should public repair amenities be located to best address concentrated failure patterns?
placements.why: Articulates the directive and empirical rationale that repair stands must be positioned at the location where flats actually occur rather than at a generic parking area.

placements.title: Publicly accessible tools require physical tethering to mitigate demonstrated theft risk
placements.frame: What physical safeguards are required to prevent loss and theft of shared public tools?
placements.why: Captures the loss prevention principle of chaining equipment to safeguard public resources against rapid theft.
